Defenses
========

[![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/1/10/Towers_Loading_Screen.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Towers_Loading_Screen.png)

[](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Towers_Loading_Screen.png "Enlarge")

Loading Screen featuring a tower of each four base heroes.

Defenses are the core to defending Etheria.  
They require Green Mana to be built, upgraded and repaired.  
Most [Heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 have 4 defenses; The [Barbarian](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Barbarian "Barbarian")
, [Gunwitch](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gunwitch "Gunwitch")
 and [Frostweaver](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Frostweaver "Frostweaver")
 have no defenses; and the [Dryad](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dryad "Dryad")
 and [Mystic](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mystic "Mystic")
 have a 5th defense.  
There are 5 types of Defenses: Towers, Blockades, Traps, Auras and Nodes.  
  

Contents
--------

Blockades
-----------

Blockades are Defenses that focus on Defense. They have wide hitboxes with a lot of health and usually do not have much range.  
Blockades deal damage, but they can also have a supporting role such as slowing or stunning enemies, and buffing heroes.

--------

Traps
-------

Traps are Defenses that focus on Offense. As health they have an certain amount of charges. They have a small trigger radius and a larger detonation radius, each trigger removes a charge.  
However, The Dryad's, Mercenary's, Countess' and Hunter's traps act more like Auras, no trigger radius and a percentage as health.  
Traps are mainly damage dealers, but they can have supporting rolls such as slowing, stunning or charming enemies.  
  
They include:

Nodes
-------

Nodes are Defenses that focus on utility, made of multiple nodes, requiring at least 2 placed nodes to be summoned. As health they have a durability displayed by a percentage. They have set ranges.  
Nodes are very useful for support such as reflecting projectiles, buffing defenses, and stunning enemies.

Interactions
--------------

### Build

Each Defense costs a specific amount of [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Green_Mana "Mana")
 to build. When building a defense it costs [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Green_Mana "Mana")
 and [Defense Units](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defense_Units "Defense Units")
. The [Defense Units](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defense_Units "Defense Units")
 lost from building a defense is refunded when the defense is either sold or destroyed.

  

### Upgrade

A Player may Upgrade a defense by [pressing Q](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Controls "Controls")
 (by default) and then left clicking on a [Defense](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defense "Defense")
.  

*   Upgrading a defense will increase its [Defense Power](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defense_Power "Defense Power")
     ratio and [Defense Health](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defense_Health "Defense Health")
     ratio.

Upgrading a defense costs different amounts of [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Green_Mana "Mana")
 for each upgrade tier:

| Upgrade | Cost |
| --- | --- |
| Tier 1 -> 2 | 50  |
| Tier 2 -> 3 | 100 |
| Tier 3 -> 4 | 150 |
| Tier 4 -> 5 | 200 |

  

### Repair

A player can repair a Defense by [pressing R](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Controls "Controls")
 (by default) and then left clicking on a defense.  
**Formula:** `Base Green Mana Cost * 75% * % of missing health`  
So repairing a defense such as the [Flameburst Tower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Flameburst_Tower "Flameburst Tower")
 for example it costs 40 [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Green_Mana "Mana")
 and repairing it from 50% health will cost 15 [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#green_mana "Mana")
.  

*   Repairing a Defense does not change in cost according to the upgrade tier. The repair cost is always based off of the base cost of the Tier 1 version of the Defense

  

### Sell

A Player may sell a defense by [pressing Z](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Controls "Controls")
 (by default) and then left clicking on the defense.  
**Formula:** `Total Green Mana Cost * 75% * % of missing health`  

*   A Defense will sell for [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Green_Mana "Mana")
     based on its condition and upgrade status.

A Defense sold in the same build phase it was built in will give a full refund, including any [green mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Green_Mana "Mana")
 spent on upgrades.  
If the defense is sold at any other point after it has been built will sell for 75% of its cost (Including Upgrade costs) times its percent health left.
